builds.name: Reference: Physical pick
builds.goal: Reference for Rengar: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: An ambush fighter who leaps from brush or camouflage, builds Ferocity and chooses empowered damage, healing-cleanse or root. Fix Ferocity and brush/ultimate entry, then choose empowered Q/W/E. Do not claim empowered heal/cleanse and damage from the same four-stack resource at once. Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
builds.summary: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Rengar: Fix Ferocity and brush/ultimate entry, then choose empowered Q/W/E. Do not claim empowered heal/cleanse and damage from the same four-stack resource at once.

Start with the early core (Youmuu, then Profane Hydra) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Ferocity. Do not treat mana regeneration as Ferocity recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Rengar's next Attack brutally stabs his target for bonus damage.

Ferocity effect: deals increased damage and grants Attack Speed. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Low health and defense; spell shields/proc cooldowns must be reset between tests.

The route fails Rengar's stated kit question: Fix Ferocity and brush/ultimate entry, then choose empowered Q/W/E. Do not claim empowered heal/cleanse and damage from the same four-stack resource at once.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Low health and defense; spell shields/proc cooldowns must be reset between tests.
Full cost 15,750 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Youmuu, then Profane Hydra. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Edge of Night, Serylda's Grudge, Guardian Angel are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: Ferocity. Do not treat mana regeneration as Ferocity recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Rengar throws a bola, dealing [55 / 100 / 145 / 190 / 235 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy hit, revealing and Slowing them by [30 / 45 / 60 / 75 / 90]% for [1.75] seconds.

Passive: Rengar will also leap Attack when Camouflaged.

Active: Rengar gains [40 / 50 / 60]% Move Speed and True Sight in a small area around the nearest enemy champion for [12 / 16 / 20] seconds.
